checks_run.procedure: Attempt a D-025 sandbox escape: plant a cwd-shadowing json.py at the repo root and let the runner's unsandboxed helper Python import it (disposable clone of the candidate commit).
checks_run.environment: disposable git clone of 7f09967 under $TMPDIR, stubbed claude simulating a sandbox-permitted repo-root write
checks_run.expected: the escape is impossible: no code runs outside the sandbox and no protected path is written
checks_run.actual: ESCAPE SUCCEEDS: the runner's 'python3 -c' / 'python3 -' helpers imported the planted json.py (log shows argv=['-c'] and argv=['-']) and the payload wrote tools/gates/PWNED-by-json-shadow.txt (a sandbox-denied path) and a .git/hooks/pre-commit, i.e. code ran OUTSIDE the sandbox as the runner. Raised as F-DG0-140.

checks_run.procedure: Attempt the stealth variant: the shadow module self-deletes and defers its protected write until after the runner's post-run config snapshot.
checks_run.expected: any escape is detected (external_config_changed non-empty, git status dirty, or auto-commit refused)
checks_run.actual: UNDETECTED: meta.external_config_changed==[], meta.bash_sandbox==true, 'git status --porcelain' empty, evidence auto-committed; the planted hook ran on the orchestrator's next ordinary commit (hook-ran.txt==HOOK-RAN-OUTSIDE-SANDBOX). All three compensating detections evaded. Supports F-DG0-140.

checks_run.procedure: Verify the escape preconditions live in my own reviewer sandbox: repo-root new files are writable, the deny list omits the root and json.py, and 'python3 -c' puts cwd on sys.path.
checks_run.command: echo probe > /home/user/My-owns/zz-sec-writable-probe.tmp; grep -c json.py <my-run>/settings.json; python3 -c 'import sys;print(repr(sys.path[0]))'
checks_run.expected: if D-025 fully confined the shell, a repo-root write would be refused
checks_run.actual: repo-root write SUCCEEDED (rc=0); settings.json denyWrite contains neither the repo root nor 'json.py' (grep count 0); python3 -c sys.path[0]=='' (cwd). Preconditions for F-DG0-140 confirmed on the live candidate.

summary: FAIL. Round-11 fixes I re-verified (F-DG0-137, 138, 139) are all correctly fixed and CLOSED_VERIFIED: local settings are no longer loaded and the sandbox refuses the reported shell vectors; the evidence auto-commit is hook-free and file-list-verified; the stale write-scopes comment is corrected. The candidate identity, determinism, prefreeze (fresh clone), test suites, CI least-privilege/pinned-actions, and secrets scan all PASS. However I found one Critical, mandatory issue that blocks the gate: F-DG0-140, an escape from the new D-025 OS Bash sandbox. Because the sandbox leaves the repository root writable for new files and run-agent.sh runs its own 'python3 -c'/'python3 -' helpers from the repository-root cwd (sys.path[0]==''), a sandboxed agent can drop a shadowing json.py (or uuid.py) that the UNSANDBOXED runner imports, executing arbitrary code as the orchestrator; a stealth variant evades config_snapshot, git status and the auto-commit file-list check with no trace. This defeats the primary mechanical control D-025 added this round (threat-model.md 'no unsandboxed escape') and enables forged gate approvals. Fix: run the runner's Python helpers with PYTHONSAFEPATH/-P/-I or from a fixed non-repository directory, and deny agent creation of top-level modules that shadow stdlib. Minor non-blocking note (no finding raised): run-agent.sh:82 still comments '--setting-sources project,local' though the flag is now 'project' only.
